title: Underground: Hacking, madness and obsession on the electronic frontier
summary: "Underground: Hacking, madness and obsession on the electronic frontier" by Suelette Dreyfus is a book published in 1997. It chronicles the exploits of Australian, American, and British black hat hackers during the late 1980s and early 1990s. The book follows notorious figures who penetrated secure networks, evaded law enforcement, and became pioneers of computer crime.
